dict.string: Courier reads your calendar to answer questions about your schedule, and adds events when you ask it to. Your calendar is read on this Mac and is never sent anywhere.
Courier reads and adds reminders when you ask it to. They stay on this Mac.
Courier looks at your photo library to find and organise pictures when you ask it to. Photos are read on this Mac and are never uploaded.
Courier reads your contacts so it can recognise the people you mention. Contacts stay on this Mac.
Courier reads files on your Desktop when you ask it about them.
Courier reads files in your Documents folder when you ask it about them.
Courier reads files in your Downloads folder when you ask it about them.
